description: Utility functions for date formatting and calculations, including date comparison, difference calculations, and string formatting for dates.

methods.name: formatLastSyncDate
methods.description: Formats the last updated date into a localized string using an external utility.

methods.name: formatDateForContextMenu
methods.description: Formats a date for display in a context menu, combining date and time.

methods.name: formatDateAndTimeForNote
methods.description: Formats a date for display in a note, optionally including time.

methods.name: dateToStringStyle1
methods.description: Converts a date to a string with date and time in a specific style.

methods.name: dateToHoursAndMinutesTimeString
methods.description: Returns a time string with hours and minutes.

methods.name: numHoursBetweenDates
methods.description: Calculates the absolute number of hours between two dates.

methods.name: areDatesInSameDay
methods.description: Checks if two dates are on the same calendar day.

methods.name: numDaysBetweenDates
methods.description: Calculates the number of days between two dates.

methods.name: addCalendarMonths
methods.description: Returns a date with the day set to the first of the month after adding months.

methods.name: getWeekdayName
methods.description: Returns the weekday name in long or short format.

methods.name: areDatesInSameMonth
methods.description: Checks if two dates are in the same month and year.

methods.name: numberOfMonthsBetweenDates
methods.description: Calculates the number of months between two dates, optionally rounding up fractional months.
